data.exact_reserve_text: The improvement in the combined operating ratio reflected a decrease in claims ratio (2015 53.7% versus 2014 57.1%), due to better than expected prior year development from within the Employers Liability and Public Liability classes, including a separate analysis of long-tail disease claims. The overall resultant benefit was a GBP 14,292,000 prior year contribution to the result (2014 GBP 23,233,000 adverse) on an annual accounting basis.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2015 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,128.632m. Management reports a prior year contribution (a net release) of GBP 14.292m driven by better-than-expected development in Employers' Liability and Public Liability, including long-tail disease claims. No gross prior-year movement figure was disclosed; the GBP 14.292m figure reported by management is a net (after-reinsurance) amount and has been used as a fallback.
